title: Icon guardrails
description: Radix icons via className="icon"; no horizontal margins inside gap-owning controls.
---

# Icon guardrails

* **MUST**: Use an icon library. Default is `@radix-ui/react-icons`. Prefer a single library; if two, Radix plus one other.
* **MUST**: Use `className="icon"` on every icon. Never `size`, `width`, or `height` props. Size via typography (`icon`, `icon h4`, `icon h1`).
* **MUST**: Space icon from label with container `gap` (own rows use `gap-0.5`). Never `ml-*` / `mr-*` / `mx-*` / `ms-*` / `me-*` on the icon (`aura/no-icon-margin`).
* **MUST**: Inside `Button` and `Badge`, add no icon gap classes — the control owns gap.
* **EXCEPTION**: `ml-auto` / `mr-auto` for layout push only.
